Trump-Netanyahu Oval Office meeting, Tuesday 28 July 2026. 90-minute meeting, concluded 12:25 p.m. ET (began ~11:03 a.m. ET). Present: VP JD Vance, Sec State Marco Rubio, Defense Sec Pete Hegseth, Middle East envoy Steve Witkoff.

White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt: "President Trump has concluded his meetings in the Oval Office with President Zelenskyy and Prime Minister Netanyahu. Both meetings were positive and productive!"

Senior Israeli official: Netanyahu held a "very good and very positive meeting" with Trump; "The two talked about all arenas — primarily Iran — and reiterated the joint commitment to prevent Iran from having nuclear weapons."

Israeli official assessment: "We are in a critical period. President Trump will make a decision soon where he is heading." Netanyahu presented Trump with Israeli intelligence on Iran and "believes there is no choice" but to attack again with "significant attacks — on nuclear facilities."

Iran reported US strikes had destroyed Bushehr International Airport and damaged 12 bridges, with tunnels and alternate routes since reopened.
